record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, compute item-frequency percentiles q_i solely from supplied training interactions and scale history input embeddings by 1.02-0.04*q_i. Unlike the previously tested popularity emphasis, this mild inverse scaling may preserve signals from less frequent observations. Keep candidate embeddings and padding unchanged; checkpoint the fixed feature table and reproduce it in the predictor writer. Preserve learned embedding design, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, mildly attenuate frequent history items using training-only frequency percentiles: scale input embeddings by 1.02−0.04*q_i. Keep candidate embeddings, padding, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer unchanged. Persist the fixed feature table in each category's single checkpoint and validate matching predictor metadata.
